author: GeForce NOW Community
description: It’s a new way into the cloud.  GeForce NOW welcomes Firefox support to the cloud, opening up another way to jump into high-performance PC gaming straight from the browser, starting today. Whether on a school laptop or everyday PC, it’s now even easier to play supported PC games without downloading a dedicated app. Plus, discover […]
title: Bring the Fire: Play Games on GeForce NOW With New Firefox Browser Support
